info.title: TAAPI.IO Universal API
info.description: TAAPI.IO provides read-only REST endpoints for real-time and historical technical indicator calculations across crypto, stocks, and ETFs.

get.description: Retrieves Accelerator Oscillator indicator data from TAAPI.IO.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: exchange
parameters.description: Exchange to source the indicator data from, such as binance.

schema.description: Exchange to source the indicator data from, such as binance.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Trading pair symbol such as BTC/USDT.

schema.description: Trading pair symbol such as BTC/USDT.

parameters.name: interval
parameters.description: Timeframe such as 1h or 1d.

schema.description: Timeframe such as 1h or 1d.

parameters.name: lengthSlow
parameters.description: Optional slow length for the oscillator calculation.

schema.description: Optional slow length for the oscillator calculation.

parameters.name: lengthFast
parameters.description: Optional fast length for the oscillator calculation.

schema.description: Optional fast length for the oscillator calculation.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.

403.description: The API key or connection cannot access this action.
